grounding.excerpt: *4 Once per permit term. The test is to be performed during the first springtime after the permit effective date, during the irrigation season
shall become effective on January 1, 2022. This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, December 31, 2026.
No evidence in this packet that the once-per-term WET test was or was not performed.

payload.rationale: The operative clause schedules the once-per-term WET test for the first springtime after the January 1, 2022 effective date, during irrigation season—not for Federal FY2025 as such. Per the oracle relation contract, ACCEPT requires establishing FY2025 as a required WET year and REJECT requires establishing it as not required; UNRESOLVED applies when the packet does not establish whether the once-per-term test remains outstanding. The packet records no evidence that the spring-2022 window test was performed or that it was not. Without that, we cannot ground whether an outstanding once-per-term obligation makes FY2025 a required monitoring year or whether the spring-2022 window already satisfied the term requirement. Unsupported uncertainty is preferred over unsupported closure.
